subject: phase corrected: past Customer Discovery — current phase is Build / execution (DR-033)
body: Recorded on mainline. Owner directive 2026-09-10 (relayed by you, confirmed in the cloud session): the company is PAST Customer Discovery. Current phase = Build / execution (engineering-led toward launch), consistent with DR-021's engineering unfreeze. Discovery is an INPUT, not the gate; the loop-state 'nothing else matters' red alarm is retired to a neutral report. The precise GTM sub-phase (pilots / revenue / launch timing) is the owner's to name and is NOT invented — left open in DR-033. Authoritative record: DR-033 in docs/DECISION_RECORDS.md, PR #584 (awaiting owner sign-off; the directive is effective now, the PR formalizes it). Surface split to avoid a two-lane collision: CLOUD owns the record (DECISION_RECORDS.md / DR-033) and this message; MAC reconciles the surface assertions you are auditing — docs/agent/DISCOVERY_LOG.md 'State:' line, scripts/loop-state.mjs discovery alarm (red/fatal -> neutral report), docs/agent/LOOP.md PHASE, and CLAUDE.md's 'the only number that moves the company is discovery conversations' line. Ping me if you want cloud to take any of those instead.
